schema.version: 1.1 (Aurora Archipelago: + felt.surface/decel_scale, felt.timed, moving_parts type 'toggle', teleports kind 'lift', vr_comfort)
schema.units: studs (1 stud = 0.3 m). Speeds studs/s, angles degrees, angular speed deg/s, times seconds.
schema.axes: Right-handed, +Y up. Each hole has its own local frame: tee at the origin, play generally toward -Z. Map/top-down view used in all docs and renders: +X to the right (east), -Z up ('north'). Facing -Z (Roblox LookVector default) the player's right is +X.
schema.world_placement: world = R_y(world_yaw) * local + world_offset. world_offset [x,y,z] studs, world_yaw degrees. Both are copied from world/world.json holes[].placement {origin, yaw_deg} (the source of truth for placement; it supersedes these copies). Roblox: holeRoot = CFrame.new(world_offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(world_yaw), 0); part.CFrame = holeRoot * localCFrame. Check: yaw 90 turns local -Z to world -X.
schema.yaw: Degrees about +Y, right-handed (Roblox CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)). Local->world: x' = lx*cos(yaw) + lz*sin(yaw); z' = -lx*sin(yaw) + lz*cos(yaw). Positive yaw = counter-clockwise in the map view.
schema.felt: Playable surface pieces. {id, zone, center:[x,y,z] = TOP-surface centre, size:[sx,sz] footprint in local x/z, yaw, slope:null|{axis:'x'|'z', rise}}. rise = surface height at the +axis end minus the -axis end (local axes); the surface is a single plane so heights at the ends are center.y +- rise/2. Collision part = a box whose top face is that plane (thickness free, suggest 0.4; build sloped pieces as a box rotated by atan(rise/len) about the local axis perpendicular to `axis`, then shifted so the top-surface centre matches). Optional flags: overlay=true (banked plane laid on top of base felt; its low edge is flush with the base), kind='bank'|'bridge'|'tunnel'|'plate'|'pier', tunnel=true (felt runs inside a decorative enclosure; physics unchanged), solid=false + thickness (bridge deck: a ball on a lower level can roll underneath). kind='plate' (H10 only): a base plate that also runs under the bobsled-run snow walls; only the part between the rails is reachable or visible. Pieces join when edges meet/overlap at equal height (tolerance 0.05). AURORA: surface='ice' + decel_scale (H4 glassy ice felt: rolling deceleration = decel_scale * (0.5 + 0.25 v); start 0.35, CALIBRATE IN STUDIO: set the collider's CustomPhysicalProperties friction so a fixed putt rolls the sim's distance). AURORA: timed={part, period_s, solid:[t_on, t_off], phase_s} (H17 aurora light span): the piece's collider exists ONLY while (t + phase_s) mod period_s is in [t_on, t_off); otherwise a ball over it falls (hazard rule). Profile in moving_parts[part].
schema.walls: Invisible collision blocks. {id, center:[x,y,z] = box centre, size:[sx,sy,sz] local box size, yaw, kind?}. kind='bumper' (static obstacle blocks: boulders, coral, crystals, hubs) uses bumper restitution 0.65; everything else is a wall (0.63). Authored rails have local Z along the run and local X = thickness 0.5; height is 1.0 above the highest felt they border (boxes along ramps are simply taller; visual rails can follow the slope). Rails sit OUTSIDE the felt edge (inner face on the edge).
schema.hazards: Out-of-bounds volumes below felt level: {id, type:'water'|'pit', center:[x,y,z] (water/pit surface), size:[sx,sz], yaw, reset:'previous_position'|'respawn', respawn?:[x,y,z], penalty:1}. A ball that leaves the felt over a hazard gets +1 stroke and is returned to where its stroke started (reset='previous_position'), or, if reset='respawn', placed at rest on the `respawn` point (a felt point, e.g. a bridge entry). Any ball leaving all felt elsewhere goes back to its stroke start (and is flagged as an escape bug). Open-sky gaps (H3, H17): the pit volume reaches down to the cloud deck; in the game the ball crossing below the felt by 3 studs (or the y 40 respawn plane) triggers the rule.
schema.drops: Intentional level changes: {id, from, to, edge, height}. The upper piece's edge is open (no rail) and the lower felt starts directly below/beyond it; the ball falls and keeps ~80% of horizontal speed. Lower felt may extend under the upper piece (the upper piece then acts as a cliff face for the lower level, unless it is a solid=false deck).
schema.moving_parts: Separate parts. type 'swing' = pendulum: {id, type:'swing', pivot:[x,y,z] (hinge point above the felt), axis (unit vector, horizontal; swing plane is perpendicular to it), amplitude_deg, period_s, phase (deg of the swing cycle at t=0), blockers (relative to the pivot with the pendulum hanging straight down)}: angle(t) = amplitude_deg*sin(360*t/period_s + phase), right-hand rule about axis; `speed` = peak angular speed at the bottom (info), range = [-amp, amp]. Types 'rotate'|'slide': {id, type, pivot:[x,y,z], axis:[ax,ay,az] unit vector, speed (deg/s for rotate, studs/s for slide, sign = direction, right-hand rule about axis), range:null (continuous) | [min,max] (ping-pong between angles in deg or offsets in studs), phase (angle/offset at t=0), blockers:[{center:[dx,dy,dz] relative to pivot at angle/offset 0, size:[sx,sy,sz], yaw, roll?}]} (roll = extra initial rotation in deg about the part axis, applied to the blocker's centre and orientation, e.g. vanes at 0/90/180/270). At time t a blocker is pivot + Rot(axis, angle(t)) * center (rotate) or pivot + center + axis*offset(t) (slide). Slides may pause: dwell:[{at: offset, s: seconds}]. One cycle = range[0] -> range[1] -> range[0] at |speed|; a stop at a range end pauses once per visit, an interior stop on both passes; phase = offset at t=0 on the forward (min -> max) pass (if a stop sits at that offset, t=0 is the start of its pause). A slide with axis [0,1,0] is a vertical piston (H5 geyser column). AURORA type 'toggle' (H17 light span): {id, type:'toggle', pivot (info), period_s, phase_s, profile:[{state, s}] (fade_in, solid, fade_out, gone), solid_window:[t_on, t_off], felt_ids:[...]}: no blockers; the listed felt pieces collide only inside solid_window of each cycle. period_s = full cycle incl. pauses (info for other types). The game script must reproduce every profile exactly (tween legs + waits), not a plain sine/ping-pong. All moving colliders: CanCollide = true, moved every frame (CFrame per Heartbeat or a constraint), bumper restitution 0.65.
schema.teleports: {id, entry:{center:[x,y,z], radius, half_size?:[hx,hz]}, exit:{center:[x,y,z], dir:[dx,dz]}, speed_factor, min_speed, max_speed, kind?}. A ball whose centre enters the entry radius (or, with half_size, the axis-aligned rectangle centre +- half_size; same level, within 0.5) reappears at exit moving along dir with speed = clamp(speed_in*speed_factor, min_speed, max_speed). AURORA kind='lift' (H5 geyser): the rectangle is the platform top; lift={cycle_s, board:[t0,t1], release_s, column}: a ball whose centre enters the rectangle while the platform is flush (cycle time in board) or from above (dropping in from the upper tier; optional lift.drop_half_size [hx, hz] widens the rectangle for these drop-ins only) is HELD on the platform (script: anchor/weld it), carried up with the column, and at cycle time release_s set moving along exit.dir from exit.center at clamp(entry speed * speed_factor, min, max). While the column is raised its side faces block like a wall.
schema.cup: {position:[x,y,z] (on felt), radius, flag}. Gameplay cup radius 0.5 stud (real cup 4.25 in = 0.36 stud diameter; enlarged ~2.8x for VR readability). Ball is holed when its centre is within radius and speed < 5.33 studs/s (1.6 m/s). flag = {pole_height 7.5 (studs above the cup felt), pole_diameter, banner_size [w,h,t], banner_color, top:[x,y,z] (pole top, the point the tee line-of-sight check aims at), collision:false}: visual only, the ball passes through it.
schema.ball: radius 0.08 stud (~real 42.7 mm ball at 0.3 m/stud). Full physics constants in the top-level 'physics' block (= tools/sim.py).
schema.ai_waypoints: {skill|'all': [{id, pos:[x,y,z], from:[zones], carry, power_scale}]} used by the sim golfer: from its current zone it aims at the furthest allowed target with line of sight (cup first, then waypoints last->first) and hits for distance + carry. cup_from (list of zones or null=all, or {skill: list|null}) limits when it goes straight for the cup. A skill-specific list replaces the 'all' list for that skill.
schema.decoration_anchors: {name, position:[x,y,z] (base centre), notes, landmark?, approx_size?, occluders?, facing?} - visual only, no collision. occluders = [{center:[x,y,z] box centre, size:[sx,sy,sz], yaw}]: the solid parts of the prop, used only by the tee->flag line-of-sight check (tools/sim.py flag_los).
schema.vr_comfort: Player-only geometry (never collides with the ball): {player_guards:[box], player_deck:{...}, tier_steps:{...}, note}. player_guards use CollisionGroup 'PlayerGuard' (collides with characters only), 4 studs high, along gap rims and both sides of rail-less ball bridges; decks/stairs carry 3.5-stud railings with a solid lower board.
schema.line_of_sight: Checked from the tee eye point (tee + 5.5 studs up) to the flag top against rails/blocks, felt and the ground under it, prop occluders, and moving blockers (reported as % of their cycle).
schema.felt_widths: Lanes 7-8 studs (2.1-2.4 m), greens 12-18 studs (3.6-5.4 m); rails 1 stud high (0.3 m), 0.5 thick (0.15 m).

physics.source: the builder's real game values (measured for Lantern Grove; mirrored as constants in tools/sim.py)
physics.max_putt_note: V_MAX derived so a full putt rolls 60 studs (18 m) on flat felt

ice.status: START VALUE - calibrate in Studio before tuning H4 further
ice.calibration: Fire 5 putts at 5.0 studs/s on the H4 ice strip; the sim rolls 28.5 studs (felt: 10.0). Set the ice collider's CustomPhysicalProperties friction until Studio matches, or report the measured distance and the designer refits decel_scale (distance = v/k - a/k^2 ln(1 + k v/a), a = 0.5 s, k = 0.25 s).

moving_parts.visual: Basalt platform 3x3 on a steam column at the cliff foot. Collider = a 3x4x3 box whose top is the platform: offset 0 = top flush with the basin felt (y 0, box y -4..0, sunk in a shaft), offset 4 = top flush with the upper green (y 4). Profile: pause DOWN 8 s (boarding window, steam simmering) -> rise 4 at 2 studs/s -> pause UP 1.5 s (big puff + whistle) -> sink 4 at 2 studs/s.

teleports.visual: Platform top = the trigger. Boarding: while the platform is flush (cycle t in [0, 8) s) a ball whose centre rolls onto it is held in its steam-vent dimple (script: anchor it, record its entry speed). It rides up; at t = 10.1 s (0.1 s into the top pause) the geyser puffs it onto the upper green from [0, 4, -29.6] along exit.dir at clamp(entry speed x 0.9, 3.5, 12) studs/s. A ball that drops in from the upper green is held and puffed out the same way at the next release. Drop-ins from the upper green use a trigger 0.15 wider each side (lift.drop_half_size, x +-1.65) so a ball slipping past the trimmed upper-rail ends into the clearance slot beside the column is held too.
